In around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="SWTORdate" /> [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Stansun]] tasked an agent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] with '''raiding''' a [[Black Sun's clinic|clinic]] being operated by the criminal [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The clinic was being used to surgical alter the faces of wanted criminals to help them escape arrest, and Stansun wanted for it to be shut down and for a list of its previous patients so they could be tracked down.<ref name="SWTORfacemerch" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The agent successfully located a passkey for the clinic and then entered the structure, [[Death/Legends|killing]] at least eight of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] medical personnel working inside and shutting the facility down. The agent then recovered the patient list from the structure's [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and returned it to Stansun.<ref name="SWTORfacemerch" />
{{Endgame}}
